concept: A profile over a few axes as one 2px shape per series with a faint wash, on recessive rings and spokes, with a table view.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a radar chart with thick saturated filled polygons and a coloured web of gridlines
default_to_avoid.kind: radar chart, spider chart, star plot
default_to_avoid.why_not: saturated fills hide each other and a coloured web shouts over the data; Pane draws thin outlines and a faint wash on a quiet grid

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: each shape carries its data colour from the palette that belongs to the content (D-031)

derivation.consequence: status is spoken in text as well as shown in colour
derivation.form: every value is also in the table view and read aloud axis by axis, so nothing is read by colour alone

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: axis names and values wear the text tones, never a series colour

options: A thin outlines with a wash
variants.picked: A thin outlines with a wash
variants.reason: A keeps overlapping shapes readable (dataviz). B hides one behind another. C loses the profile at a glance.

ring.why: rings are recessive hairlines in the grid tone

spoke.why: spokes are hairlines in the grid tone from the centre to each axis

shape.why: each series is a 2px outline over a faint wash of its own data colour

dot.why: the axis in focus marks each series with a dot ringed in the surface

live.why: a hidden live line says every value on the axis in focus

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the shapes keep their data colours so series stay apart
